users.notes: Multi-user-ready per CLAUDE.md, but Part 4's login check is a hardcoded 'user'/'password' comparison in Python, not a DB lookup. password_hash exists so a real credential check can be swapped in later without a schema change; it is not read by the app yet.

boards.notes: user_id is UNIQUE to enforce the MVP's '1 board per user' rule at the DB level. No name/title column — BoardData has no board-level name today, and adding one would be speculative.

columns.notes: Columns are fixed in count/order but renamable (business requirement), so 'slug' is the stable identifier code and the AI feature key off; 'title' is the user-editable display name. 'position' is the 0-based left-to-right order. slug values are the current frontend seed ids verbatim (col-backlog, col-discovery, col-progress, col-review, col-done) so the API layer can pass slug straight through as BoardData's column.id with zero translation, and existing data-testid="column-<id>" hooks in the frontend/e2e tests keep working unchanged.

cards.notes: position is the 0-based order within the column (used for both same-column reorder and cross-column drop, mirroring lib/kanban.ts's moveCard). The API layer formats BoardData's card.id as 'card-<id>' to match the existing 'card-1'..'card-8' convention the e2e tests (kanban.spec.ts) already assume.
